reels.title: M40 TENNIS
reels.yt_title: Better gear won't fix it. Reps will. #Shorts
reels.caption:
Better gear won't fix it. Reps will. 🏓

Same goal, two plans. One practices 10 minutes a day. One buys better gear. Day 30, he misses again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: a 120-hit rally vs $960 of paddles on the wall.

Listen to the rally get longer.

Send this to someone who buys gear first.

#pingpong #tabletennis #practice #discipline #habits

reels.title: M39 BARABAN
reels.yt_title: You can't watch your way to rhythm #Shorts
reels.caption:
You can't watch your way to rhythm. 🥁

Same dream, two plans. One plays drums 10 minutes a day. One watches drum covers. Day 30, off beat again. Next day, he plays again. A year later: 98% on beat vs 912 covers watched.

Listen to the groove change.

Send this to a future drummer.

#drums #drummer #practice #discipline #motivation
